newsitem.title: COTE D'IVOIRE: PRESS DIGEST - Ivory Coast - Oct 28.
newsitem.headline: PRESS DIGEST - Ivory Coast - Oct 28.

text.p: These are significant items in the Ivorian press on Monday. Reuters has not verified these items and does not vouch for their accuracy.

- Ivory Coast's ruling Democratic Party holds landmark congress, the first ordinary congress not chaired by independence president Felix Houphouet-Boigny who died in 1993; President Henri Konan Bedie to make keynote speech 1130 GMT

- Veteran opposition activist Memel-Fote Harris of the Ivorian Popular Front says in interview that ruling party advances doctrine of ethnic superiority; denounces this as anti-democratic and a threat to future stability - Port handling company SIVOM (Societe Ivoirienne d'Operations Maritimes) and Ivorian Privatisation Committee take full-page advertisement inviting investors to buy SIVOM shares from today (October 28); price 12,000 CFA francs.
- Five million women in Ivory Coast, which has a population of around 14 million, can neither read nor write, U.N. Educational, Scientific and Cultural Organisation (UNESCO) figures suggest.
- Ivory Coast become African women's handball champions
defeating Algeria 35-19 in the final in Benin
